source_notes: The SSD and HDD summary tables of docs/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volume-types are raw HTML in the snapshot; their rows cannot be quoted (M3 markup). Values were taken from the type pages (general-purpose, provisioned-iops, hdd-vols) and the footnotes.

Source difference: gp3 throughput price. www/ebs/volume-types lists $0.04/provisioned MB/s-month over 125 MiBps; the www/ebs/pricing example uses $0.06 per provisioned MB/s-month. Both recorded (ebs-gp3-performance-price-volume-types-page, ebs-gp3-throughput-price-pricing-page); M12 may queue a conflict for the registrar.

Contradicts older material: volume modification limit is 'up to four times within a rolling 24-hour period' (ebs-modify-four-per-24-hours), not one modification per 6 hours. gp3 maxima are 80,000 IOPS, 2,000 MiB/s, 64 TiB (doc history 2025-09-26), not 16,000 / 1,000 / 16 TiB.

volatility frequently-changing was set on gp3 maxima and io2 latency facts because the values changed in 2025 per the doc history but the old values are not on the saved pages (changed stays null; the change lens dates them).
